status: Method declared. Collection, training and evaluation require the canonical parent re-baseline to qualify, an implementation freeze, prepared data inventories and a GPU resource contract. No automatic training.
tokenizer: Canonical tokenizer.json with the per-encode guard in every collection, training and evaluation process.

experience.source: Training split only (256 episodes). Integration, development and confirmation goals never enter training.
experience.rollouts: Parent samples 8 complete episodes per training case in the deterministic workspace under the frozen policy limits. Temperature 0.8, top-p 0.95, seed derived from case ID and sample index.
experience.verification: Replay each transcript and score it with the frozen outcome scorer. Accept a complete episode when every round passes. Accept the leading successful rounds of a partial episode as round-level experience.
experience.masking: Train on assistant generations only. A generation whose tool call was rejected stays in context with no loss.
experience.selection: At most 4 distinct accepted trajectories per case, preferring fewer model calls, then sample index.
experience.near_policy: Report each accepted trajectory's mean assistant-token negative log-likelihood under the parent in its uncoached context. Coached trajectories above the largest uncoached accepted value are rejected.

coaching.trigger: Training cases or rounds without an accepted uncoached rollout.
coaching.card: Procedure: 1) Call list_documents with the exact project name from the request. 2) The latest approved version is the approved document with the highest revision; use an older revision only when the user names it. 3) Read every document you will cite. 4) Use calculate for each arithmetic step and shift_date for each date offset, copying values exactly from tool results. 5) Call save_draft with every field, citing only documents you read. 6) For a correction, start from the fields of your most recent save_draft, change only what the user asks, recompute derived values with tools and save again before replying. 7) After saving, reply with one short confirmation and no tool call.
coaching.rollouts: 8 samples with the card appended to the system instruction; same verification.
coaching.distillation: Store accepted coached trajectories with the card removed. The card is identical for every case, contains no case values and never appears during integration or evaluation.

preservation_replay.prompts: 256 generated prompts across conversation state, JSON instructions and single tool calls. Different templates, tools, entities and values from the 24 anchors and 16 reference tasks; checked by identity and 8-gram overlap.
preservation_replay.targets: Parent greedy responses under the canonical tokenizer, recorded before training.
preservation_replay.mixture: One replay sequence per three experience sequences in every accumulated update.

arms.parent: Unchanged Granite 4.1 3B with the common tool runtime.
arms.update: Update existing q_proj and v_proj matrices in layers 32..39 (62,914,560 parameters). Parent retained for routing and rollback; its storage is charged.
arms.addition: Frozen backbone with rank-16, alpha-32 LoRA on q_proj and v_proj in layers 32..39 (1,048,576 parameters), zero-output initialization, not merged.

training.sequences: One sequence per accepted trajectory; all trainable assistant spans labeled. Loss normalized per trajectory so each accepted conversation has equal weight.
training.checkpoint: Terminal step only, with optimizer/RNG state, data and source roots. No checkpoint selection.

selection.features: Frozen parent final-layer hidden state at the first assistant-generation boundary; request, system instruction and tool definitions only.
selection.estimates: On each of the 64 integration episodes run parent and trained arm once greedily and 4 times sampled; success rate is the mean of the 5 outcomes.
selection.labels: Target the trained arm when its success rate exceeds the parent's, weighted by the absolute difference. Equal rates carry no weight. All targets arm: constant arm. No arm targets: constant parent.
selection.gate: One logistic linear gate (2560 weights plus bias), zero initialization, L2-normalized features, AdamW lr 0.001, weight decay 0.01, 128 updates, batch 8, seed 27092027; threshold 0.5, tie selects parent.
selection.activation: Select once at the first request of a workspace episode; keep that selection through its follow-ups.
selection.accounting: Charge feature prefill, every integration rollout, gate fit and rejected work.

development_gate.protected: Every canonical parent development success and every canonical anchor success.

confirmation_gate.opens: Once, only after both trained arms finish and the addition passes development.

growth_claim: A2 requires beating the parent and matching the equal-data update at a fraction of its trained parameters and update traffic. Whether separate modules beat repeated shared-weight updates is measured in A3, across cohorts, by cumulative retention under a declared budget.
decentralized_role: Rollouts are the parallel contributor workload. Each is replayed and rescored without trusting its producer or regenerating it; the parent-likelihood check rejects off-policy text. One compute group trains the module; replicas serve it. No settlement or payment is part of this experiment.

budget.note: Collection and training need a GPU resource contract with exact hardware, package hashes and memory measurements before any paid run. Evaluation reuses the CPU runtime of the canonical parent baseline.

stop_rule: Publish failed gates unchanged. No opened-final method shopping, automatic relaunch or silent serving change. If the canonical parent exceeds 20/24 on development, add harder workflows under a new data freeze before training.
